name: proof.memoryIndexArrayIncrement.overflow-step-dropped.1
diff:
--- a/Solidity/Calculus/Rules.lean
+++ b/Solidity/Calculus/Rules.lean
@@ -593,3 +593,3 @@
   | memoryIndexArrayIncrement :
-      dl{ ⟨[ mv[ie]⊕⊕; ]⟩ ⇝ { memory := write(memory, mv[ie], mv[ie] ± 1) } ⟨[ ]⟩ }
+      dl{ ⟨[ mv[ie]⊕⊕; ]⟩ ⇝ { memory := write(memory, mv[ie], mv[ie]) } ⟨[ ]⟩ }
   | storageFieldIncrementUnfoldLeftFst :

diagnostics.message:
Solidity.Taclet.memoryIndexArrayIncrement: Tactic `rfl` failed: The left-hand side
  Stmt.step k✝ m✝ (Stmt.incDec op✝ hp✝ (OpLoc.mindex mk✝ (MPath.var mv✝ hmv✝) ie✝))
is not definitionally equal to the right-hand side
  Premise.update
    (Upd.nil.snoc
      (UpdElem.memory
        (Tms.MTerm.write Tms.MTerm.memory (Tms.MAddr.at mk✝ (Tms.ITerm.pv mv✝) ie✝.lower)
          (Tms.MValT.val (Tms.Term.read Tms.MTerm.memory (Tms.MAddr.at mk✝ (Tms.ITerm.pv mv✝) ie✝.lower))))))

C✝ : Contract
k✝ : Nat
m✝ : Modality
Γ✝ : Ctx
p✝ : PrimTy
op✝ : IncDec
hp✝ : p✝.isNumeric = true
x✝ : RefTy
mk✝ : ArrTy x✝ (Ty.prim p✝)
mv✝ : Idx Γ✝ (LTy.mem x✝)
hmv✝ : (Ty.ref x✝).mapFree = true
ie✝ : Simple C✝ Γ✝ PrimTy.uint
⊢ Stmt.step k✝ m✝ (Stmt.incDec op✝ hp✝ (OpLoc.mindex mk✝ (MPath.var mv✝ hmv✝) ie✝)) =
    Premise.update
      (Upd.nil.snoc
        (UpdElem.memory
          (Tms.MTerm.write Tms.MTerm.memory (Tms.MAddr.at mk✝ (Tms.ITerm.pv mv✝) ie✝.lower)
            (Tms.MValT.val (Tms.Term.read Tms.MTerm.memory (Tms.MAddr.at mk✝ (Tms.ITerm.pv mv✝) ie✝.lower))))))
